```{r}
#| output: asis
#| label: tbl-agent-per-infection-rate
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$tbl_cap_engine else sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$`tbl-cap`'
#| tbl-cap-location: top

check_outlier_interpretation <- FALSE

# The version of the table the report renders: the reporting groups of the
# released classification, or the full ontology when the parameter asks for
# it. A neoipcr that predates the classification engine carries no ontology
# version, and the groups version is all there is to show.
# NEOIPC-COMPAT(infectious-agent-engine): remove the fallback once
# reports/compatibility.yml lists v0.0.0.9009 or later as tested and minimum
# together; see the marker of the same scope in `_setup.qmd`.
ia_slot <- if (identical(infectious_agent_rows, "ontology"))
  "infectious_agent_detection_rate_per_agent_ontology_table" else
  "infectious_agent_detection_rate_per_agent_table"
tbl_data <- benchmark_data[[ia_slot]]
if (is.null(tbl_data)) {
  ia_slot <- "infectious_agent_detection_rate_per_agent_table"
  tbl_data <- benchmark_data[[ia_slot]]
}

# Rows keyed by node_id come from the classification engine; rows keyed by
# their printed label come from the taxonomy that preceded it. Decided before
# the guard because the table caption reads it, and the caption is evaluated
# even where no data renders the table.
ia_engine <- "node_id" %in% names(tbl_data)
ia_groups <- identical(ia_slot, "infectious_agent_detection_rate_per_agent_table")

# Conditionally render table only if department data exists
if (!is.null(tbl_data) &&
    sum(tbl_data$n_own, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {

  has_reference <- "pooled_ref" %in% names(tbl_data) &&
    any(!is.na(tbl_data$pooled_ref))
  check_outlier_interpretation <- has_reference

  # A refused benchmark join still contributes all-NA `_ref` columns for the
  # table. Dropping them when there is no reference is what makes the table
  # show department rows only, as the not-comparable callout says it does.
  if (!has_reference)
    tbl_data <- tbl_data |> dplyr::select(!dplyr::ends_with("_ref"))

  cw <- compute_col_widths(tbl_data, stub_min = 32, has_reference = has_reference, base_font_size = 9)

  # Reset to the default CI pattern in case an earlier sibling table mutated
  # the shared `ci_pattern` to inline.
  ci_pattern <- ci_pattern_default

  # The infection-type columns beside the pooled share. Each row's own share
  # among the confirmed infections of that type is what the Partner Report
  # shows; the denominators themselves are not printed.
  ia_type_headers <- c(
    bsi = sR$primary_sepsis_bsi_sc,
    hap = sR$pneumonia_sc,
    nec = sR$necrotizing_enterocolitis_sc,
    ssi = sR$ssi_sc)
  ia_types <- if (ia_engine)
    ia_type_headers[paste0("pooled_", names(ia_type_headers), "_own") %in%
                     names(tbl_data)] else
    character(0)

  tbl <- tbl_data |>
    dplyr::select(-tidyselect::any_of(c("n_ref", ".ontology_path_own"))) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      group = dplyr::if_else(
        !ia_engine & stringr::str_detect(group, "spp."),
        paste0("*", stringr::str_extract(group, "^(.+) spp\\.(.*)$", 1), "* spp.", stringr::str_extract(group, "^(.+) spp\\.(.*)$", 2)),
        group
      )) |>
    dplyr::rename(
      !!sR$table_headers$count := "n_own",
      !!sR$table_headers$rate := "pooled_own",
      !!sR$table_headers$pooled := tidyselect::any_of("pooled_ref"),
      !!sR$table_headers$q1 := tidyselect::any_of("q1_ref"),
      !!sR$table_headers$q2 := tidyselect::any_of("q2_ref"),
      !!sR$table_headers$q3 := tidyselect::any_of("q3_ref"))

  if (length(ia_types) > 0) {
    ia_type_old_cols <- stats::setNames(
      paste0("pooled_", names(ia_types), "_own"), unname(ia_types))
    tbl <- tbl |> dplyr::rename(!!!ia_type_old_cols)
  }

  ci_cols_to_drop <- character(0)
  if (!include_rate_ci)
    ci_cols_to_drop <- c(ci_cols_to_drop, "ci_lower_own", "ci_upper_own")
  if (!include_pooled_ci)
    ci_cols_to_drop <- c(ci_cols_to_drop, "ci_lower_ref", "ci_upper_ref")
  if (!include_quartile_ci)
    ci_cols_to_drop <- c(ci_cols_to_drop,
      "q1_ci_lower_ref", "q1_ci_upper_ref",
      "q2_ci_lower_ref", "q2_ci_upper_ref",
      "q3_ci_lower_ref", "q3_ci_upper_ref")
  if (length(ci_cols_to_drop) > 0)
    tbl <- tbl |> dplyr::select(-tidyselect::any_of(ci_cols_to_drop))

  # Columns no cell shows: the engine's tree bookkeeping and the per-row
  # denominators. `level` stays, hidden, for the stub indent; `rank`,
  # `node_id`, and `parent_id` are consumed below as precomputed row vectors.
  # The benchmark join has suffixed every measure: the infection-type
  # measures appear for the reference too, and only the department's pooled
  # share of a type is ever shown.
  if (ia_engine) {
    ia_type_own <- as.vector(outer(
      c("n_", "total_", "ci_lower_", "ci_upper_"),
      names(ia_types), paste0))
    ia_type_ref <- as.vector(outer(
      c("n_", "total_", "pooled_", "ci_lower_", "ci_upper_"),
      names(ia_types), paste0))
    tbl <- tbl |> dplyr::select(-tidyselect::any_of(c(
      "node_id", "parent_id", "rank", "quartile_departments_ref",
      "n_total_only_own", "n_total_only_ref", "total_own", "total_ref",
      ia_type_own, paste0(ia_type_ref, "_ref"))))
  }

  # Row styling: the engine styles by `rank` and the row identity; the older
  # table styled by `taxon`.
  ia_node_id <- if (ia_engine) as.character(tbl_data$node_id) else character(0)
  ia_summary <- if (ia_engine)
    !is.na(ia_node_id) & grepl("^[a-z_]+\\|", ia_node_id) else
    rep(FALSE, nrow(tbl_data))
  ia_bold <- if (ia_engine) {
    (tbl_data$level == 0) |
      (ia_groups & !is.na(ia_node_id) & !ia_summary) |
      ia_summary |
      (!ia_groups & !is.na(tbl_data$rank) & tbl_data$rank %in%
         c("Domain", "Kingdom", "Realm", "Subkingdom", "Phylum",
           "Order", "Genus", "Group"))
  } else {
    rep(FALSE, nrow(tbl_data))
  }
  ia_italic <- if (ia_engine) {
    !is.na(tbl_data$rank) & tbl_data$rank %in% c(
      "Realm", "Domain", "Subkingdom", "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Subphylum",
      "Class", "Subclass", "Order", "Suborder", "Family", "Subfamily",
      "Species", "Subspecies", "Serotype", "Variety")
  } else {
    rep(FALSE, nrow(tbl_data))
  }

  tbl <- tbl |>
    gt(rowname_col = "group") |>
    sub_missing() |>
    gt::fmt_markdown(columns = c("group")) |>
    gt::tab_options(
      latex.header_repeat = TRUE,
      latex.use_longtable = TRUE,
      table.width = pct(100),
      table.font.size = cw$font_size,
      footnotes.marks = "extended"
    ) |>
    fmt_number(
      columns = !(tidyselect::any_of(sR$table_headers$count) | tidyselect::matches("^(group|level|taxon)$")),
      decimals = 1,
      sep_mark = sR$digit_group_separator,
      min_sep_threshold = 2,
      locale = locale_gt) |>
    fmt_integer(
      columns = sR$table_headers$count,
      sep_mark = sR$digit_group_separator,
      min_sep_threshold = 2) |>
    gt::tab_stub_indent(
      rows = gt::everything(),
      indent = gt::from_column(column = "level")
    )

  if (ia_engine) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        locations = cells_stub(rows = ia_bold)
      ) |>
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(style = "italic"),
        locations = cells_stub(rows = ia_italic)
      )
  } else {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(
          weight = "bold"
        ),
        locations = cells_stub(
          rows = taxon %in% c(
            "none",
            "domain",
            "kingdom",
            "order",
            "genus",
            "coag_type")
        )
      ) |>
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(
          style = "italic"
        ),
        locations = cells_stub(
          rows = taxon %in% c(
            "domain",
            "kingdom",
            "order",
            "species")
        )
      )
  }

  tbl <- tbl |>
    cols_hide(columns = any_of(c("level","taxon"))) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = list(
        cells_column_spanners(),
        cells_column_labels(),
        cells_row_groups()
      )
    ) |>
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = interpolate_translation(
        if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$n_footnote_engine
                     else sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$n_footnote,
        column = sR$table_headers$count),
      locations = cells_column_labels(columns = sR$table_headers$count),
      placement = "right"
    ) |>
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = interpolate_translation(
        if (ia_engine)
          sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_footnote_engine %||%
            sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_footnote
        else
          sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_footnote,
        column = sR$table_headers$rate),
      locations = cells_column_labels(columns = sR$table_headers$rate),
      placement = "right"
    )

  if (include_rate_ci && "ci_lower_own" %in% colnames(tbl$`_data`)) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(sR$table_headers$rate, "ci_lower_own", "ci_upper_own"),
        pattern = ci_pattern,
        rows = !is.na(tbl_data$pooled_own)
      )
  }
  if (include_pooled_ci && "ci_lower_ref" %in% colnames(tbl$`_data`)) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(sR$table_headers$pooled, "ci_lower_ref", "ci_upper_ref"),
        pattern = ci_pattern,
        rows = !is.na(tbl_data$pooled_ref)
      )
  }

  # The infection-type shares, each with its own interval.
  for (ia_type in names(ia_types)) {
    ia_type_col <- ia_types[[ia_type]]
    ia_type_ci <- paste0(c("ci_lower_", "ci_upper_"), ia_type, "_own")
    if (include_rate_ci && all(ia_type_ci %in% colnames(tbl$`_data`))) {
      tbl <- tbl |>
        gt::cols_merge(
          columns = c(ia_type_col, ia_type_ci[1], ia_type_ci[2]),
          pattern = ci_pattern_inline,
          rows = !is.na(tbl_data[[paste0("pooled_", ia_type, "_own")]])
        )
    }
  }

  if ("q1_ci_lower_ref" %in% colnames(tbl$`_data`)) {
    if (include_quartile_ci) {
      has_boot <- !is.na(tbl$`_data`[["q1_ci_lower_ref"]])
      tbl <- tbl |>
        gt::cols_merge(
          columns = c(sR$table_headers$q1, "q1_ci_lower_ref", "q1_ci_upper_ref"),
          pattern = ci_pattern,
          rows = has_boot
        ) |>
        gt::cols_merge(
          columns = c(sR$table_headers$q2, "q2_ci_lower_ref", "q2_ci_upper_ref"),
          pattern = ci_pattern,
          rows = has_boot
        ) |>
        gt::cols_merge(
          columns = c(sR$table_headers$q3, "q3_ci_lower_ref", "q3_ci_upper_ref"),
          pattern = ci_pattern,
          rows = has_boot
        )
    } else {
      tbl <- tbl |> gt::cols_hide(columns = tidyselect::any_of(c(
        "q1_ci_lower_ref", "q1_ci_upper_ref",
        "q2_ci_lower_ref", "q2_ci_upper_ref",
        "q3_ci_lower_ref", "q3_ci_upper_ref")))
    }
  }

  # The infection-type columns take fixed widths, the stub gives up the
  # space; a share with its interval needs the wider inline pattern.
  ia_type_w <- if (length(ia_types) > 0) 8 else 0
  ia_stub_w <- max(cw$stub - length(ia_types) * ia_type_w, 22)

  if (has_reference) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      cols_width(
        stub() ~ pct(ia_stub_w),
        sR$table_headers$count ~ pct(cw$n),
        sR$table_headers$rate ~ pct(cw$rate),
        sR$table_headers$pooled ~ pct(cw$pooled),
        sR$table_headers$q1 ~ pct(cw$q),
        sR$table_headers$q2 ~ pct(cw$q),
        sR$table_headers$q3 ~ pct(cw$q),
        tidyselect::any_of(unname(ia_types)) ~ pct(ia_type_w)
      ) |>
      tab_spanner(
        label = sR$own_data_label,
        columns = tidyselect::any_of(c(
          sR$table_headers$count, sR$table_headers$rate, unname(ia_types))),
        id = "department_data"
      ) |>
      tab_spanner(
        label = sR$reference_data,
        columns = c(
          sR$table_headers$pooled,
          sR$table_headers$q1,
          sR$table_headers$q2,
          sR$table_headers$q3),
        id = "reference_data"
      ) |>
      tab_spanner(
        label = sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_name,
        columns = tidyselect::any_of(
          c(
            sR$table_headers$rate,
            sR$table_headers$pooled,
            sR$table_headers$q1,
            sR$table_headers$q2,
            sR$table_headers$q3)),
        id = "infectious_agent_detection_rate",
        level = 2
      ) |>
      tab_footnote(
        footnote = interpolate_translation(
          sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$pooled_footnote,
          column = sR$table_headers$pooled),
        locations = cells_column_labels(columns = sR$table_headers$pooled),
        placement = "right")
  } else {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      cols_width(
        stub() ~ pct(ia_stub_w),
        sR$table_headers$count ~ pct(cw$n),
        sR$table_headers$rate ~ pct(cw$rate),
        tidyselect::any_of(unname(ia_types)) ~ pct(ia_type_w)
      ) |>
      tab_spanner(
        label = sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_name,
        columns = tidyselect::any_of(
          c(
            sR$table_headers$rate)),
        id = "infectious_agent_detection_rate"
      )
  }

  if (length(ia_types) > 0) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      tab_spanner(
        label = sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$type_columns_label,
        columns = tidyselect::all_of(unname(ia_types)),
        id = "agent_type_shares",
        level = if (has_reference) 2 else 1
      ) |>
      tab_footnote(
        footnote = sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$type_share_footnote,
        locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = "agent_type_shares"),
        placement = "right"
      )
  }

  # Formula footnote shown in all variants (GAP-04)
  tbl <- tbl |>
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = md(
        paste0(
          "$$\\text{",
          sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_name,
          "} = \\frac{\\text{",
          if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_numerator_engine else
            sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_numerator,
          "}}{\\text{",
          if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_denominator_engine else
            sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_denominator,
          "}} \\times ",
          format_integer(100),
          "$$"
        )),
      locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = "infectious_agent_detection_rate"),
      placement = "right"
    )

  if (ia_engine) {
    # A share is flagged where its denominator is sparse; the Total, a count
    # and not a share, is flagged on its own count. The denominators are not
    # printed, so the footnote marks the share itself.
    ia_sparse <- !is.na(tbl_data$pooled_own) & tbl_data$level > 0 &
      tbl_data$total_own < sparse_threshold
    ia_sparse_total <- !is.na(tbl_data$pooled_own) & tbl_data$level == 0 &
      tbl_data$n_own < sparse_threshold
    if (any(ia_sparse, na.rm = TRUE) || any(ia_sparse_total, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      sparse_note <- interpolate_translation(if (include_rate_ci) sR$sparse_data_footnote else sR$sparse_data_footnote_no_ci, threshold = sparse_threshold)
      if (any(ia_sparse, na.rm = TRUE))
        tbl <- tbl |>
          gt::tab_footnote(
            footnote = sparse_note,
            locations = cells_body(
              columns = sR$table_headers$rate,
              rows = ia_sparse),
            placement = "right")
      if (any(ia_sparse_total, na.rm = TRUE))
        tbl <- tbl |>
          gt::tab_footnote(
            footnote = sparse_note,
            locations = cells_body(
              columns = sR$table_headers$count,
              rows = ia_sparse_total),
            placement = "right")
    }

    # The Total's infectious agents that no row counts, from the engine's
    # `n_total_only_own` on the Total row.
    ia_total_only <- tbl_data$n_total_only_own[tbl_data$level == 0][1]
    if (!is.null(ia_total_only) && !is.na(ia_total_only) && ia_total_only > 0) {
      tbl <- tbl |>
        gt::tab_footnote(
          footnote = interpolate_translation(
            sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$total_only_footnote,
            count = format_integer(ia_total_only)),
          locations = cells_body(
            columns = sR$table_headers$count,
            rows = tbl_data$level == 0),
          placement = "right")
    }
  } else {
    if (any(!is.na(tbl_data$pooled_own) & tbl_data$n_own < sparse_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      sparse_note <- interpolate_translation(if (include_rate_ci) sR$sparse_data_footnote else sR$sparse_data_footnote_no_ci, threshold = sparse_threshold)
      tbl <- tbl |>
        gt::tab_footnote(
          footnote = sparse_note,
          locations = cells_body(
            columns = sR$table_headers$count,
            rows = !is.na(tbl_data$pooled_own) & tbl_data$n_own < sparse_threshold),
          placement = "right")
    }
  }

  # n.o.s. definition source note: the engine marks a residual row by its
  # identity, the older table by its taxon. The footnote beside `nos_footnote`
  # explains residuals above the genus, where the genus footnote stops short.
  ia_residual <- if (ia_engine)
    !is.na(ia_node_id) & grepl("~n\\.o\\.s\\.$", ia_node_id)
  else
    tbl_data$taxon == "species_nos"
  if (any(ia_residual, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::tab_source_note(source_note = sR$nos_footnote)
    if (ia_engine && any(ia_residual & !grepl("\\|genus/", ia_node_id),
                         na.rm = TRUE))
      tbl <- tbl |>
        gt::tab_source_note(
          source_note = sR$residual_above_genus_footnote)
  }
  # The groups version alone carries the summary block beside its tree.
  if (ia_engine && ia_groups && any(ia_summary, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::tab_source_note(
        source_note = sR$summary_block_note)
  }

  tbl
} else {
  no_data_table()
}
```

```{r}
  cat("\n\n::: {.callout-warning}\n")
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
if (check_outlier_interpretation) {
  states <- metric_registry[[ia_slot]]
  if (has_outliers(states)) {
    grouped <- group_outliers(
      states, ia_slot, sR, metric_registry,
      labels = metric_labels[[ia_slot]])
    outlier_text <- format_outlier_text(grouped, sR)
    if (nchar(outlier_text) > 0) {
      cat("\n\n::: {.callout-tip}\n")
      cat("## ", sR$outlier$heading, "\n\n")
      cat(outlier_text, "\n")
      cat(":::\n")
    }
  }
}
```
